title: BDA · Fall 2026
description: Midterms, quizzes, assignments and finals for the fall semester, from the course syllabi matched against the class calendar.
check: Professors can move dates. Check Blackboard and the syllabus before relying on them. Spanish groups, rooms and times can differ: untick what isn't yours.

items.subject: P&S individual assignment
items.notes: Mon 12 Oct is a national holiday (no classes).

items.subject: A&DS midterm
items.notes: Sessions 1-14: Big O, binary search, arrays vs linked lists, selection sort, recursion and the call stack, quicksort, hash tables and collisions, OOP (inheritance, special methods), tree traversals, heaps. Tip: redo labs 1-6 without notes; trace quicksort and heap insertions by hand.

items.subject: Time Series midterm
items.notes: Sessions 1-8: ACF plots, additive vs multiplicative decomposition, Box-Cox, mean/naive/seasonal naive/drift benchmarks, SES and its alpha, Ljung-Box. Know the fpp3 function names.

items.subject: Technology with Impact test
items.notes: Closed-book. You write up and diagram your own ecological artefact, so design it in advance.

items.subject: Español oral final
items.notes: Dec 2 is busy: Maths group presentation, Programming demos and a final report due 23:59.

items.subject: Español written final
items.notes: More than 4 absences bars you from this final.

items.subject: P&S final
items.notes: 12:00-14:50. 3 one-sided A4 formula sheets and a calculator allowed. Missing data, assumptions, PCA, clustering, regression, Lasso/Ridge, trees, logistic regression, discriminant analysis.

items.subject: Programming final
items.notes: AI isn't allowed for any submission in this course.

items.subject: Maths final
items.notes: Linear algebra: systems, matrices, vector spaces, eigenvalues, inner products.
